Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 77: December 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #77 shipped to subscribers in November 2007 (bearing the cover date of December 2007 for Issue 77). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #77 arrived during the peak holiday shopping season, featuring high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and exclusive media content:

Need for Speed: ProStreet (closed-course street racing simulation)
The Simpsons Game (animated action-adventure platformer)
Blazing Angels 2: Secret Missions of WWII (flight combat action)
Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga (co-op action-adventure)
Battlestar Galactica (Xbox Live Arcade space combat simulation)
Switchball (Xbox Live Arcade physics-based 3D puzzle-platformer)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews and trailers for late-2007 and early-2008 titles—including features for Mass Effect, Devil May Cry 4, and Left 4 Dead, along with OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
